additional_context: The current core source/fhir.ini active [profiles] section points element-extensions at source/profiles/element-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains current ElementDefinition extension definitions and has no occurrence of the old invalid path. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no contradictory community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reported illegal context path is absent from current core source, the active core element extension spreadsheet has no extension definitions to correct, and the moved extension-pack sources also lack the obsolete path.
